capabilities.description: List scoped terminal sessions available to the agent.
Return bridge runtime status and policy configuration.
List user-attached files in the current AI chat scope.
Read a user-attached file from the current AI chat scope.
Cancel in-flight operations for a chat session.
Resume write operations for a cancelled chat session.
Get metadata for a single scoped session.
Close a terminal session previously opened by host_open in the current AI scope.
Execute a short command in a terminal session and wait for completion.
Start a long-running command in a terminal session.
Poll incremental output from a long-running terminal job.
Stop a long-running terminal job.
List a remote directory over the session file backend (SFTP or SCP-mode).
Read a remote file over the session file backend (SFTP or SCP-mode).
Write a remote file over the session file backend (SFTP or SCP-mode).
Download a remote file to a local path.
Upload a local file to a remote path.
Get remote file metadata over the session file backend (SFTP or SCP-mode).
Get the remote home directory for a session.
Create a remote directory over the session file backend (SFTP or SCP-mode).
Delete a remote file or directory over the session file backend (SFTP or SCP-mode).
Rename a remote file or directory over the session file backend (SFTP or SCP-mode).
Change remote file permissions over the session file backend (SFTP or SCP-mode).
Get host metadata from the vault.
List saved hosts in the vault (metadata only — no passwords or keys).

Open a vault host by creating a new terminal tab and starting the connection. Returns the new sessionId so you can run terminal/SFTP tools against it. Use vault_hosts_list first when you only know the label or hostname.
Create vault hosts from structured host objects. Use when the user wants to add/create a host (Vault → Hosts). NOT for Vault → Notes sidebar documentation.
Update selected fields on an existing vault host. Use vault_hosts_list first to resolve the hostId.
Delete a saved vault host by id. Use vault_hosts_list first to resolve the hostId.
Parse known host export file formats (PuTTY, MobaXterm, CSV, SecureCRT, ssh_config) into vault hosts. For arbitrary unstructured text, map to host objects and use vault_hosts_create instead.
Read host metadata notes attached to a saved host (Host Details panel — not Vault sidebar Notes).
Update host metadata notes on a saved host (Host Details panel — not Vault sidebar Notes).
List notes in Vault → Notes (markdown notes visible in the vault sidebar).
Get a Vault → Notes entry by id (full markdown content).
Create a note in Vault → Notes sidebar (markdown documentation). NOT for adding SSH hosts — use vault_hosts_create for that.
Update an existing Vault → Notes entry by id.
Delete a Vault → Notes entry by id.
List reusable vault identities without passwords, private keys, or passphrases.
List reusable proxy profiles without credentials.
List vault groups and their safe default settings.
Create a vault group with optional default connection settings.
Update or rename a vault group and its default connection settings.
Delete a vault group, moving its hosts to the root unless deleteHosts is true.
List code snippets stored in the vault.
Get a single code snippet from the vault.
Run a vault snippet or automation script in a terminal session. Text snippets paste shell commands; scripts (kind=script) run via the nct JavaScript runtime.
Create a vault snippet or automation script (set kind=script for nct automation).
Update an existing vault snippet or automation script by id.
Delete a vault snippet or automation script by id.
List automation scripts (kind=script) in the vault.
Get a single automation script including JavaScript source.
Create an automation script using the nct JavaScript API. Call scripts_reference first when authoring nct automation.
Update an automation script by id (partial fields).
Delete an automation script and remove host connect bindings.
Run an automation script in a terminal session via the nct runtime. Set wait=true to block until completion.
Return Netcatty automation script syntax: nct API, triggers, host targeting, and source wrapping rules.
List automation script runs (optionally filter by sessionId).
Stop a running automation script by runId.
Pause a running automation script by runId.
Resume a paused automation script by runId.
Set host IDs, dynamic group paths, or targetsAllHosts for an automation script. onConnect host IDs sync host connect queues.
List resolved onConnect automation scripts for a host (global, dynamic group, then host queue).
Set ordered onConnect script IDs for a host (host-specific queue; globals run separately).
List persisted port forwarding rules.
List active port forwarding tunnels.
Create a persisted port forwarding rule.
Update a persisted port forwarding rule.
Duplicate a persisted port forwarding rule.
Delete a persisted port forwarding rule.
Start a port forwarding tunnel for a rule.
Stop an active port forwarding tunnel.
Read stored tool output by handle id when a prior tool result was truncated.
Get information about the current workspace, including all terminal sessions and their connection status.
Get detailed information about a specific terminal or SFTP session.
Read a bounded slice of the current terminal screen or scrollback from the active AI scope.
Search the web for current information when configured in AI settings.
Fetch and read the content of an HTTPS URL.
